external_observations.evidence_span: My second time here when visiting Oslo. The service was nice and good quality at decent prices. Had a normal hair cut and a long beard trimming and shaping. I was very happy with the result.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
Was up north for over a week and in desperate need of a shave when I came to Oslo.  PelsPels was only one block away from the hotel I am staying in so I booked an appointment with Irmina.

She did an excellent job!  One of the best shaves I’ve had.  My face is smooth and clean.  It was a very relaxing experience, and the face massage as she was working the aftershave balm in was the icing on the cake.  Afterwards she told me about the
Products she used and I bought the shave cream and balm.

If I come back to Oslo, I will certainly stop by again!
